sloka: रामः च सह सौमित्रिः प्रेषितः सह सीतया ।तम् अपश्यन् प्रियम् पुत्रम् मही पालो महा यशाः ॥२-७२-५१॥
transliteration: rāmaḥ ca saha saumitriḥ preṣitaḥ saha sītayā ।tam apaśyan priyam putram mahī pālo mahā yaśāḥ ॥2-72-51॥

translations.english: The renowned ruler of the earth (king Dasaratha), unable to behold (the sorry state of) his beloved son and stricken by filial grief, merged into the five elements (died).
